_spec: SNG-654 §2–§3 (Aevi 2026-09-25): regional prices. Replaces the dead `the_crossing` profile with a live `the_center` one at ONE flat price (Erik's ruling), renames `the_unspooling` → `unspooling`, and adds 15 profiles for regions that had none (valley, the Echo Vale, the Deepwood, 12 foothill market towns). ⚠️ Principle: a region's own produce is never priced below ordinary where live holds already sell it; gradients come from what places lack. Applied by po/tools/apply_region_prices.cjs.

the_crossing.note: ⛔ ERIK 2026-09-25: "the crossroad's prices are roughly the same for everyone because you can find contingents of traders from all the lands looking to buy and sell just like you are." So ONE flat price for every good (×1.8) — a reliable outlet from anywhere, and never the best price for anything, which is what this profile's own earlier note asked for and its numbers (high × scarce, ×3.6) contradicted. ⚠️ regionId was `the_crossing`, which no place carries — the Crossing's region is `the_center` — so this profile priced nothing until SNG-654. No dead list: it is the only market that wants everything.

add.note: SNG-654 (Aevi): the home valley. ⚠️ WHAT ITS HOLDS MAKE STAYS AT ORDINARY — raw material, living stock, parts, stone — so no live save earns less at home for this profile existing. The gradient comes from where it sells TO: the Crossing (33 days, ×1.8 on everything) and the Echo Vale (33 days, ×3.6 on living stock). It wants what it cannot grow or make: remedies, tuned tools, kindled glass.

SNG-654 (Aevi): terraced sound-cities and a photonic plateau edge above a marsh full of refugees. They make tuned things and kindled glass (abundant — do not sell them instruments) and feed nobody: living stock and remedies at high need and scarce (×3.6), timber and hide at high. ⚑ THE VALLEY'S OTHER OUTLET, 33 days: a hold that grows things does better here than at the Crossing.

SNG-654 (Aevi): the Deepwood. ⛔ RAW MATERIAL IS A HARD ZERO — hide, sinew, timber: the ents will not buy the wood, at any price, from anyone. Living stock is abundant (it is a forest). The Burnscar is a wound the Moot is still tending: remedies at high need, scarce.

SNG-654 (Aevi): the outward frontier and Keelmouth's harbour. Everybody leaving buys a blade: arms at high need, scarce (×3.6); timber and hide for the boats at high. Luxuries come in by sea (abundant). ⚑ Longshore is 26 days away — the closest market pair on the ring.
SNG-654 (Aevi): the outfitter on the road — where expeditions are kitted. Working parts and pack animals at high need; blades and remedies scarce. Nobody here reads.

add.tradition: (plains market, on the way to the Told Ground)
add.note: SNG-654 (Aevi): wide farmland — it grows its own (living stock abundant) and builds in stone on ground with none (dressed stone at high). A farm country that breaks its tools: working parts high and scarce (×3.6).

SNG-654 (Aevi): the staging yard for the Palelands and the Unmade. It buys what the pale pays for, to carry it on — living stock at high and scarce (×3.6) — and is full of salvage walked out of the Unmade (abundant).
SNG-654 (Aevi): the hearth town the Ashwardens come down to. Remedies at high and scarce (×3.6) — the pale's own want, bought a step early.

SNG-654 (Aevi): a thin-watered town below the Numinous Reach and the Kept Hours. Pilgrims pass through buying keepsakes (luxuries high); it lives on little and imports its timber and stock (scarce). Charters and attestations are cheap here — the hour-keepers write them.

add.tradition: (market at the edge of the dark)
add.note: SNG-654 (Aevi): the last lit town before the Umbral Depths. Kindled glass and lantern-work at high need, scarce (×3.6) — nobody goes down without light, and nobody comes back with any.

SNG-654 (Aevi): the Gearlands' own foothill market, and it has their appetite — raw material at high and scarce (×3.6), salvage at high — and their surplus: parts and instruments abundant (do not bring them here).
SNG-654 (Aevi): rootkin country's market — everything that grows is cheap here (living stock and remedies abundant), and everything that is MADE is wanted: working parts at high and scarce (×3.6).

add.tradition: (the kindled row, below the Radiant Wastes)
add.note: SNG-654 (Aevi): the blazeborn's market town. Light is everywhere (abundant); food and hide are not — living stock at high and scarce (×3.6), raw material at high.

SNG-654 (Aevi): where the climb begins. Dressed stone for the stair at high; offerings and keepsakes for the ascent (luxuries high); charters to present above (documents scarce). The seraphic do not want weapons carried up.

SNG-654 (Aevi): the market at the lip of the Descent — it buys what people need to go down and what they bring up: salvage at high and scarce (×3.6), arms at high. Down there, a keepsake is worth nothing (luxuries abundant).
